The implications of the proposed changes resonate particularly in affluent neighborhoods, where access to top-performing schools is a significant concern for families. Activists and parents express fears that these alterations will disproportionately affect poorer and minority students, limiting their access to quality education and exacerbating existing inequalities within the D.C. public school system.
